loginLead: Log in with your VTC mail account. You do not need an API key.
loginNote: You log in once per machine. The login lasts 7 days and is renewed when you log in again.
codeLead: Paseo opened a VTC login page in your browser. Log in there; Paseo connects by itself.
noBrowserLead: For example, Paseo runs on a remote server. Open this link on any machine:
waiting: Waiting for you to log in...
penLead: You logged in successfully, but your account is not in a team yet. An admin will add you to your department's team.
penAuto: This screen updates by itself when an admin adds you.
renewBanner: Your login ends on {{date}}. Log in again to keep it for 7 more days.
copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it.
logoutUnreachable: Could not reach Agent-Memory. If you remove the login from this machine, the key stays valid until {{date}}.
baseUrlHint: The https:// address of Agent-Memory on the tailnet.
deviceNameHint: Leave empty to use this machine's name.
setupNone: No supported tool was found on this machine.
setupLater: The tools above were set up once, when this key was issued. A tool you install later is not set up automatically: follow the steps in the Agent-Memory guide for it. Logging out removes this setup again.
setupFailedTitle: Agent-Memory could not set up your tools
removalRunning: Removing the Agent-Memory setup from your tools...
removalLead: You logged out, but these tools still hold Agent-Memory settings:
mcpOn: Claude Code, Codex and omp agents opened in Paseo get the agent-memory MCP. A change applies when an agent opens.
mcpInvalid: The agent-memory MCP is off because its saved setting cannot be read. Reset it to turn it on again.

harnessState.partial: Set up without the project hook

harnessErrors.settings_invalid: The settings file is not valid JSON, so it was left as it is.
harnessErrors.codex_profile: The Codex config selects a profile, so it was left as it is.
harnessErrors.models_invalid: The omp models file could not be edited safely, so it was left as it is.
harnessErrors.own_provider: This tool already uses its own provider, so it was left as it is.
harnessErrors.toml_unsupported: The Codex config uses a form of model_providers that cannot be edited safely, so it was left as it is.
harnessErrors.no_models: Agent-Memory listed no models for omp.
harnessErrors.write_failed: A file could not be written.

setupErrors.no_proxy: Agent-Memory did not give a proxy address, so no tool was set up.
setupErrors.bad_key: The key has a form that the plugin does not write into files, so no tool was set up.

removalResults.kept: Kept: it was changed after the plugin wrote it.
removalResults.failed: Could not be removed. Remove it by hand.

reasons.login_expired: The login link expired. Try again.
reasons.key_limit: Your account has too many keys. Ask an admin to remove old ones.
reasons.key_mismatch: The saved login did not match. Log in again.
reasons.not_configured: Enter the Agent-Memory address below first.
reasons.invalid_base_url: The Agent-Memory address is not valid.
reasons.server_changed: The address changed. Log in to the new server.

errors.server_unavailable: Agent-Memory is not available now. Retrying.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.logout_unreachable: Could not log out on the server.
errors.logout_failed: Could not log out. Try again.
